40017883.author: पदार्थः
40017883.content: शोककर्शितः immersed in grief, राघवः Raghava, तस्य his, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तेन by that रक्षसा Rakshasa, यत् which, उक्तम् was, व्यक्तम् spoken, नोपधारयते could not know

40017883.author: Translation
40017883.content: Immersed in grief, Raghava could not make out the words spoken by Vibheeshana.

40017884.author: पदार्थः
40017884.content: ततः then, परपुरञ्जयः who can win over enemies, रामः Rama, धैर्यम् courage, अवष्टभ्य picked up, उपासीनम् seated near, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, कपिसन्निधौ in front of Vanaras, उवाच said

40017884.author: Translation
40017884.content: Then Rama, who can win over enemies, picked up courage, said to Vibheeshana seated near him in front of Vanaras.

40017885.author: पदार्थः
40017885.content: नैरृताधिपते Rakshasa (progeny of Nirriti presiding the southwest), विभीषण Vibheeshana, ते you, यत् that which, वाक्यम् words, उक्तम् spoken, तत् that, भूयःspeak, श्रोतुम् wish to hear, इच्छामि wish, ते you, यत् that which, इवक्षितम् to be conveyed, तत् that, भूयः repeat again, श्रोतुम् wish to hear, इच्छामि desire

40017885.author: Translation
40017885.content: "O Lord of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana! I wish to hear the words spoken by you. You may repeat that which you wanted to convey. I wish to hear."

40017886.author: पदार्थः
40017886.content: सःविभीषणः Vibheeshana, वाक्यम् words, उदाहृतम् skilled in expression, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, पुनः again, इदंवाक्यम् these words, यत्नात् to him, बभाषे spoke again

40017886.author: Translation
40017886.content: Vibheeshana, who was skilled in expression, spoke again as follows on hearing Raghava's words.

40017887.author: पदार्थः
40017887.content: महाबाहो mighty armed, वीर hero, त्वया by you, गुल्मनिवेशनम् from their respective places, यथा that which, आज्ञप्तम् command, तत् then, त्वदाक्यसमनन्तरम् according to your order, तथा like that, अनुष्ठितम् has been done

40017887.author: Translation
40017887.content: " After your command the army has been divided and placed at respective places as you said."

40017888.author: पदार्थः
40017888.content: तानि all of them, अनीकानि army forces, सर्वाणि all, समन्ततःcollected, विभक्तानि divided, यूथपाश्चैव where ever, यथान्यायम् in the respective places, विभागशः separately, विन्यस्ताः assigned

40017888.author: Translation
40017888.content: All the army forces have been collected, divided, and assigned to respective places separately.

40017889.author: पदार्थः
40017889.content: महाप्रभो O great Lord, भूयः being, मम me, विज्ञाप्यम् which is to be submitted, तत् that, शृणुष्व hear, त्वयि to you, अकारणसन्तप्ते afflicted without any cause, वयम् you, सन्तप्तहृदयाः pained at heart

40017889.author: Translation
40017889.content: "O great Lord! Hear me, which is yet to be submitted by me to you. You are afflicted without cause and pained at heart."

40017890.author: पदार्थः
40017890.content: राजन् king, इमम् this, शोकम् agony, मिथ्या false, आगतम् has set in, सन्तापम् worry, त्यज give up, तत् then, शत्रुहर्षविवर्धिनी it enhances the joy of enemy, इयम् this, चिन्ता anxiety, त्यज्यताम् giveup

40017890.author: Translation
40017890.content: "O king! Give up this false agony which has set in. It enhances the joy of the enemy. Give up this anxiety."

40017891.author: पदार्थः
40017891.content: वीर hero, ते to you, सीता Sita, प्राप्तव्या attain, निशाचराः Rakshasas, हन्तव्याश्च will be exterminated, उद्यमः effort, क्रियताम् resorted, हर्षः enthusiasm, समुपसेव्यताम् will recover

40017891.author: Translation
40017891.content: "Let efforts be made to recover Sita. Let enthusiasm be restored to recover Sita. Rakshasas will be exterminated."

40017892.author: पदार्थः
40017892.content: रघुनन्दन delight of Raghus, मे my, हितम् advice, वचः words, श्रूयताम् you may listen, अयम् this, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded, निकुम्भिलायाम् Nikumbhilam, सम्प्राप्तम् reach, रावणिम् Indrajith, आहवे on reaching, धनुर्मण्डलनिर्मुक्तै: discharged from his bow in circular form, आशीविषविषोपमैः like deadly poison of venomous serpents, हन्तुम् kill, साधु excellent, यातु march ahead

40017892.author: Translation
40017892.content: "Delight of Raghus! You may listen to my words of advice. Let Saumithri march ahead to Nikumbhilam accompanied by the great army. On reaching, let Lakshmana who is capable of killing Indrajith discharge venomous serpents like deadly poisonous arrows from his bow in circular form and kill Rakshasas."

40017893.author: पदार्थः
40017893.content: रघुनन्दन delight of Raghus, मे my, हितम् advice, वचः words, श्रूयताम् you may listen, अयम् this, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded, निकुम्भिलायाम् Nikumbhilam, सम्प्राप्तम् reach, रावणिम् Indrajith, आहवे on reaching, धनुर्मण्डलनिर्मुक्तै: discharged from his bow in circular form, आशीविषविषोपमैः like deadly poison of venomous serpents, हन्तुम् kill, साधु excellent, यातु march ahead

40017893.author: Translation
40017893.content: "Delight of Raghus! You may listen to my words of advice. Let Saumithri march ahead to Nikumbhilam accompanied by the great army. On reaching, let Lakshmana who is capable of killing Indrajith discharge venomous serpents like deadly poisonous arrows from his bow in circular form and kill Rakshasas."

40017894.author: पदार्थः
40017894.content: वीरेण being hero, तेन by him, तपसा by austerity, स्वयम्भुवः creator, वरदानात् boon received, ब्रह्मशिरः Brahmasira weapon, अस्त्रम् arrow, प्राप्तम् attained, कामगाः coursing at his will, तुरङ्गमाः horses

40017894.author: Translation
40017894.content: "Lakshmana, being heroic received Brahmasira weapon from the creator by austerity and also horses which can course according to his will."

40017895.author: पदार्थः
40017895.content: सःएषः he in that way, सैन्येनसह accompanied by army, निकुम्भिलाम् Nikumbhilam, प्राप्तःकिल reached, कर्म act of sacrifice, कृतम् doing, उततिष्ठेद्यदि comes from there, सर्वान् all, नःnot, हतान् killed, विद्धि know

40017895.author: Translation
40017895.content: "Indrajith has reached Nikumbhilam accompanied by the army. If he completes the sacrifice and comes from there after completion of the sacrifice, know that we are all killed.

40017896.author: पदार्थः
40017896.content: महाबाहो mightyarmed, इन्द्रशत्रो enemy of Indra, यः he who, रिपुः enemy, निकुम्भिलाम् Nikumbhilam, असम्प्राप्तम् not reached, आहुताग्निं च propitiated your fire, आततायिनम् cause of your death, त्वाम् you, हन्यात् killed, सः he, ते to you, वधः kill, सर्वलोकेश्वरेण Lord of all worlds, धीमतः wise, तस्य his, इत्येवम् in this way, वरः boon, दत्तःgiven, एषः that way, वधः, विहितः ordained

40017896.author: Translation
40017896.content: "O mighty armed Rama! that enemy of yours, while you have not reached Nikumbhilam and not propitiated fire sacrifice, can cause your death. Such a boon was granted to him, the enemy of Indra by the Lord of all worlds."

40017897.author: पदार्थः
40017897.content: महाबाहो mightyarmed, इन्द्रशत्रो enemy of Indra, यः he who, रिपुः enemy, निकुम्भिलाम् Nikumbhilam, असम्प्राप्तम् not reached, आहुताग्निं च propitiated your fire, आततायिनम् cause of your death, त्वाम् you, हन्यात् killed, सः he, ते to you, वधः kill, सर्वलोकेश्वरेण Lord of all worlds, धीमतः wise, तस्य his, इत्येवम् in this way, वरः boon, दत्तःgiven, एषः that way, वधः, विहितः ordained

40017897.author: Translation
40017897.content: "O mighty armed Rama! that enemy of yours, while you have not reached Nikumbhilam and not propitiated fire sacrifice, can cause your death. Such a boon was granted to him, the enemy of Indra by the Lord of all worlds."

40017898.author: पदार्थः
40017898.content: महाबल endowed with extraordinary prowess, राम Rama, इन्द्रजितः Indrajith, वधाय by destruction, सन्दिशस्व order now, तस्मिन् with his, हते death, ससुहृज्जनम् all his kinsfolk, रावणं Ravana, हतम् are killed, विद्धि you may know

40017898.author: Translation
40017898.content: Rama, you are endowed with extraordinary prowess! Order now for the destruction of Indrajith as with his death Ravana and all his kinsfolk are killed, you may know.

40017899.author: पदार्थः
40017899.content: विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken, सत्यपराक्रम of truthful valour, रौद्रस्य fierce, तस्य his, मायाम् conjuring skill, जानामि known to me

40017899.author: Translation
40017899.content: Hearing Vibheeshana, Rama said" the conjuring skills of Indrajith of truthful valour is known to me."

40017900.author: पदार्थः
40017900.content: ब्रह्मास्त्रवित् skilled in the use of Brahma's weapon, प्राज्ञः wise, महामायः intelligent in conjuring, महाबलःendowed with mighty prowess, सःhe, सवरुणान् Varuna and others, देवानपि Devatas also, सङ्ग्रामे in war, असंज्ञान् unconscious, करोति does

40017900.author: Translation
40017900.content: He is skilled in the use of Brahma's weapon, intelligent in conjuring, endowed with mighty prowess, and can make even varuna and Devatas unconscious.

40017901.author: पदार्थः
40017901.content: महायशः of great fame, वीर hero, सरथस्य with that chariot, अन्तरिक्षे sky, चरतः going, तस्य his, गतिः movement, अभ्रसम्प्लवे coursing through clouds, सूर्यस्येव, like sun न ज्ञायते cannot be known

40017901.author: Translation
40017901.content: When he moves in his chariot in the sky like the Sun coursing through clouds is difficult to know.

40017902.author: पदार्थः
40017902.content: राघवः Raghava, दुरात्मनः wicked minded, रिपोः enemy, मायावीर्यम् conjuring valour, ज्ञात्वा knowing, कीर्तिसम्पन्नम् richly endowed with fame, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, इदंवचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke

40017902.author: Translation
40017902.content: Knowing the wickedminded enemy of conjuring valour, Rama spoke as follows to Lakshmana, richly endowed with fame (of winning wars).

40017903.author: पदार्थः
40017903.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara king's, यत् that which, बलम् army, तेन by that, सर्वेण entire, सम्वृतः surrounded by, हनूमत्प्रमुखैः Hanuaman as chief, यूथपैश्चैवसह accompanied by commanders of the army, सहसैन्येन with army, ऋक्षपतिना Lord of Bears, जाम्बवेन with Jambavantha, सम्वृतःprotected, मायाबलविशारदम् well versed in tricks, तम् him, राक्षससुतम् son of Rakshasa, जहि put an end

40017903.author: Translation
40017903.content: "O Lakshmana! Surrounded by the entire army of Vanara king, with Hanuman as commander in chief of the army, protected by Jambavan, king of Bears, put an end to the son of Ravana who is well versed in tricks."

40017904.author: पदार्थः
40017904.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara king's, यत् that which, बलम् army, तेन by that, सर्वेण entire, सम्वृतः surrounded by, हनूमत्प्रमुखैः Hanuaman as chief, यूथपैश्चैवसह accompanied by commanders of the army, सहसैन्येन with army, ऋक्षपतिना Lord of Bears, जाम्बवेन with Jambavantha, सम्वृतःprotected, मायाबलविशारदम् well versed in tricks, तम् him, राक्षससुतम् son of Rakshasa, जहि put an end

40017904.author: Translation
40017904.content: "O Lakshmana! Surrounded by the entire army of Vanara king, with Hanuman as commander in chief of the army, protected by Jambavan, king of Bears, put an end to the son of Ravana who is well versed in tricks."

40017905.author: पदार्थः
40017905.content: तस्य his, मायानाम् by his conjuring, अभिज्ञः knows well, महात्मा great soul, अयंरजनीचरः this night ranger, सचिवैःसार्थम् with ministers, त्वाम् you, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुगमिष्यति will follow

40017905.author: Translation
40017905.content: "This great soul, night ranger (Vibheeshana) who knows his conjuring tricks well, will follow behind you with ministers."

40017906.author: पदार्थः
40017906.content: सविभीषणः Vibheeshana, अत्यद्भुतपराक्रमः of wonderful courage, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचःwords, श्रुत्वा hearing, कार्मुकश्रेष्ठम् best of bow, जग्राह took up

40017906.author: Translation
40017906.content: "On hearing Raghava's words, Lakshmana of wonderful courage took up the best of bows accompanied by Vbheeshana."

40017907.author: पदार्थः
40017907.content: सन्नद्धः fully equipped, कवची with shield, खङ्गी swords, सशरः shafts, हेमचापधृत् golden bow, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, हृष्टः joyfully, रामपादौ Rama's feet, उपस्पृश्य touching with reverence, अब्रवीत् spoke

40017907.author: Translation
40017907.content: Saumithri fully equipped with shields, swords, shafts, and golden bow joyfully, touched Rama's feet with reverence and spoke.

40017908.author: पदार्थः
40017908.content: अद्य now, मत्कार्मुकोन्मुक्ताः released from my bow, शराः arrows, रावणिम् son of Ravana's, निर्भिद्य piercing, हंसाः swans, पुष्करिणीमिव descend into lotus pond, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभिपतिष्यन्ति will drop

40017908.author: Translation
40017908.content: Now the arrows released from my bow will drop in Lanka, just as swans descend into lotus pond and pierce into Ravana's son.

40017909.author: पदार्थः
40017909.content: अद्यैव this day, महाचापगुणच्युताः loosed from mighty bow, मामकाः of mine, शराः arrows, रौद्रस्य fierce, तस्य his, शरीरम् body, भित्त्वा splitting, तम् him, विधमिष्यन्ति will kill

40017909.author: Translation
40017909.content: "Today loosed from my mighty bow, the arrows will split his fierce body and kill him."

40017910.author: पदार्थः
40017910.content: द्युतिमान् brilliant, सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother, अग्रतःin front, एवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा spoken, रावणिवथाकाङ्क्षी desirous of killing Ravana's son, त्वरितो speedily, ययौ went

40017910.author: Translation
40017910.content: Brilliant Lakshmana, having spoken that way in front of his brother, went speedily desirous of killing Ravana's son.

40017911.author: पदार्थः
40017911.content: सः he, गुरोः eldest brother, पादौ feet, अभिवाद्य saluting, प्रदक्षिणं च going round, कृत्वा done, निकुम्बिलाम् Nikumbhila, रावणिपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, चैत्यम् sanctuary, अभिययौ proceeded

40017911.author: Translation
40017911.content: Saluting the feet of the eldest brother and going round him, Laksmana proceeded to Nikumbhila sanctuary ruled by Ravana.

40017912.author: पदार्थः
40017912.content: राजपुत्रः prince, प्रतापवान् valourous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भ्रात्रा brother, कृतस्वस्त्ययनः receiving blessing, विभीषणेन by Vibheeshana, सहितःaccompanied by, त्वरितः quickly, ययौ went

40017912.author: Translation
40017912.content: Lakshmana, a valourous prince having received blessings from his eldest brother, went quickly accompanied by Vibheeshana.

40017913.author: पदार्थः
40017913.content: तदा then, वानराणाम् Vanaras, बहुभिः many, सहस्रैः thousands, वृतः surrounded, हनूमान् Hanuman, सामात्यः ministers, विभीषणश्च and Vibheeshana, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अन्वगात् followed

40017913.author: Translation
40017913.content: Then Hanuman surrounded by many thousands of Vanaras, Vibheeshana and ministers followed Lakshmana.

40017914.author: पदार्थः
40017914.content: महता huge, हरिसैन्येन vanara army, सवेगम् at speed, अभिसंवृतः surrounded, पथइ on the way, विष्ठितम् standing, ऋक्षराजबलंचैव Jambavan also, ददर्श saw

40017914.author: Translation
40017914.content: Lakshmana also saw Jambavan standing on the way, with a huge Vanara army surrounded while going speedily.

40017915.author: पदार्थः
40017915.content: मित्रनन्दनः delight of friends, सःसौमित्रिः that Saumithri, दूरम् from distance, अध्वानम् afar, गत्वा gone, दूरात् from distance, व्यूहम् ranged, आश्रितम् battle array, राक्षसेन्द्रबलम् Rakshasa army, अपश्यत् witnessed

40017915.author: Translation
40017915.content: Lakshmana, the delight of friends, witnessed from a distance the Rakshasa army arranged in battlearray.

40017916.author: पदार्थः
40017916.content: अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, सःरघुनन्दनः that delight of Raghu race, धनुष्पाणिः wielding bow, प्राप्य taking, मायायोगम् conjurer, तम् him, ब्रह्मविधानेन by the creator Brahma, विजेतुम् prepared to win, तस्थौ stood

40017916.author: Translation
40017916.content: The tamer of enemies and delight of the Raghu race, Lakshmana stood wielding bow in hand ready to win the conjurer conferred with boon by the creator Brahma.

40017917.author: पदार्थः
40017917.content: प्रतापवान् of great valour, राजपुत्रः prince, विभीषणेन toVibheeshana, वीरेण hero, अङ्गदेन to Angada, तथा so also, अनिलसुतेन च son of firegod, सहितः together

40017917.author: Translation
40017917.content: Accompanied by Vibheeshana, and also hero Angada, so also the son of fire god, Hanuman, Lakshmana stood together.
